about.title: Menlo Park Product Liability Claims
about.longDescription: Menlo Park sits at a crossroads of tech offices, retail along El Camino Real, and homes tucked near US-101 and Marsh Road, all places where everyday products get used, and sometimes fail. A malfunctioning appliance, a car part that gives out, a tool that breaks mid-use, or a children's item with a hidden hazard can turn an ordinary afternoon into a trip to the hospital. California law generally lets injured people pursue strict liability claims, meaning the focus is on whether the product itself was defective, not on proving anyone was careless. That covers design flaws, manufacturing errors, and inadequate warnings alike. If a product hurt you or someone in your household anywhere in Menlo Park or San Mateo County, we can review your options at no cost and with no obligation.
commonInjuries: Burns from malfunctioning appliances or batteries
Lacerations from broken tools or machinery

whyChoose.title: Why Menlo Park Residents Choose Us

items.title: Strict Liability Can Simplify the Case
items.desc: Under California law, you often don't need to prove the manufacturer was careless, just that the product was defective and caused harm. This can make certain claims more straightforward than typical negligence cases.

items.title: Multiple Parties May Share Responsibility
items.desc: Manufacturers, distributors, and even the retailer who sold the item in Menlo Park may all bear liability. Our team can help sort out who's accountable.

items.title: Preserving the Product Matters
items.desc: California claims often hinge on the physical product as evidence. We can advise you on safely keeping it intact rather than discarding or repairing it.

items.question: Do I have to prove the manufacturer was negligent?
items.answer: Generally, no. California product liability claims frequently rely on strict liability, which focuses on whether the product itself was defective rather than on the manufacturer's conduct. We can review the details of your situation to see how this applies.

items.question: What should I do with the product that hurt me?
items.answer: Try to keep it exactly as it was at the time of the injury, don't repair it, throw it away, or alter it. The product itself is often central evidence in these claims, and we can guide you on how to store or document it properly.

items.question: I live near Marsh Road or El Camino Real in Menlo Park, does location matter for my claim?
items.answer: Where the injury happened doesn't change the legal standard, but local details like where the product was purchased or used can matter for figuring out which businesses were involved. We handle product liability claims in San Mateo County and can help sort through those specifics.

items.question: Is there a cost to consult with us?
items.answer: No. There is no cost for a free consultation, and we typically work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover compensation.
